name: ENERGY STAR Unique ID
description: The ENERGY STAR Unique ID (ESUID) is a string of seven numbers EPA assigns to an ENERGY STAR model or set of models with unique performance characteristics. This ESUID is unique to both the model and product specification version and is assigned by EPA upon receipt of certification information from the certification body. Each row within the product list will have a unique ESUID. Developers may wish to use this ESUID to track information on certified models in their information systems.

name: ENERGY STAR Partner
description: An organization that signed a Partnership Agreement with EPA to manufacture or private label ENERGY STAR qualified products.

name: Brand Name
description: An identifier assigned by the manufacturer or private labeler to a product or family/series of products for sales and marketing purposes.

name: Model Name
description: An identifier assigned by the manufacturer or private labeler to a product or family/series of products for sales and marketing purposes.

name: Model Number
description: A distinguishing identifier, usually alphanumeric, assigned to a product by the manufacturer or private labeler.

name: Additional Model Information
description: This indicates for the qualified model or family, family members, additional model names, model numbers and other identifying information associated with a product or family/series of products for sales and marketing purposes. Other identifying information includes, but is not limited to, SKUs, UPC codes, retail numbers, and/or descriptions of models included/not included in the reported Model Family.

name: UPC
description: UPC codes provided by partners for ENERGY STAR certified products. The brand, model name and model number continue to serve as the identifiers used to establish certification. The UPC code data below is intended to aid in identification of ENERGY STAR models. UPC code data is not provided for all certified models.

name: DC-input or AC-input
description: This indicates if the EVSE is intended to receive AC- or DC-input power, or if it is capable of accepting both.

name: Single Phase or Three Phase
description: This indicates if the EVSE is single-phase, three-phase, or both.

name: Product Configuration
description: This indicates whether the model is a Distributed Product Configuration (a DC-output EVSE that has its functional components distributed between more than one separate enclosures) or an All-in-One Configuration (a DC-output EVSE that has all of its components in one enclosure).

name: Connector Type
description: This indicates the type(s) of connector shipped with this product: combined charging system (CCS), CHAdeMO, Tesla, or other)

name: Network Capability
description: Indicates whether the model is able to connect to a network.

name: Network Connection Types Available
description: This indicates which, if any, network protocols that the model is shipped with, and None if the model does not have any network connected capability.

name: Output Cord Length (ft.)
description: This indicates cord set length or mean cord set length, if multiple-output. If 0, there is no cord provided with the model during testing.

name: Output Cord Gauge (AWG)
description: The cord set American Wire Gauge (AWG) used for test or mean cord set AWG if multiple-output. If no cord was provided for testing, then there will be a NA.

name: Screen Area, if EVSE has high res display (in2)
description: The screen area, if the EVSE has a high resolution display.

name: Maximum Measured Luminance of the High Res Display (candelas per m2)
description: Maximum luminance of the display, if EVSE has a high resolution display measured at maximum available brightness.

name: Automatic Brightness Control Capable?
description: This indicates if this model is capable of the self-acting mechanism that controls the brightness of a display or lamp as a function of ambient light.

name: Connected Capable
description: This indicates if this model meets the optional connected functionality criteria, as defined in the specification, which pertain to enabling demand response functionality through the use of  open standards, capabilities such as scheduling, and the ability to respond to defined demand response signals.

name: DR Protocol
description: Indicates which standardized protocol is used to send load management messages to the unit.

name: Connects Using
description: System can communicate using these protocols for sending messages and requests, some of which work wirelessly and some with wires (communication standard media/network layer).

name: Protocols Used to Support Smart Charging
description: Indicates if the model has the transceiver and/or necessary hardware to support smart charging (i.e. beyond simple managed charging with pulse width modulation or CANBus) using any of these station-to-vehicle protocols.

name: Network Security Standards
description: Describes the standards implemented in the product that provide privacy best practices and additional security by preventing or detecting network compromises.

name: Is Broadband Internet Connection Needed for Demand Response?
description: Describes whether the product can participate in utility demand response programs without the home having a broadband connection.

name: Auxiliary Product Features
description: Indicates if the model has the auxiliary features to meet regulatory requirements such as credit card readers, revenue grade meters, ISO 15118 PLC boards, RFID and those helpful to consumers such as speakers, display, cameras and occupancy sensing.

name: Product Features
description: This indicates other features of this EVSE (e.g., vehicle to grid capability, Smart Home Energy Management System (SHEMS) compatibility, etc.).

name: Maximum Available Output Power
description: Indicates the maximum output power available for this model.

name: Maximum Nameplate Output Current (A) AC-Input
description: Indicates the maximum nameplate output current for an AC-input EVSE.

name: Rated Input Voltage (V) AC-Input
description: Indicates the rated input voltage for an AC-input EVSE.

name: Number of Outputs
description: Indicates the number of outputs available for this model.

name: Integral Battery Bank
description: Indicates if the EVSE has an integral, internal battery bank.

name: No Vehicle Mode Input Power (watts) AC-Input
description: This indicates the No Vehicle Mode Input Power for AC- Input EVSE. If the model has a high resolution display with ABC enabled, this is the average Input Power for the high and low illuminance conditions.

name: No Vehicle Mode Total Allowance (watts)
description: The No Vehicle Mode Total Allowance is the maximum amount of power allowed in this mode for the model to be ENERGY STAR certified.

name: No Vehicle Mode Power Factor AC-Input
description: This indicates the No Vehicle Mode Power Factor for all AC-input models. If the model has a high resolution display with ABC enabled, this is the average No Vehicle Mode Power Factor for the high and low illuminance conditions.

name: Partial On Mode Input Power (watts) AC-Input
description: This indicates the Partial On Mode Input Power for AC-input EVSE. If the model has a high resolution display with ABC enabled, this is the average Input Power for the high and low illuminance conditions.

name: Partial On Mode Total Allowance (watts)
description: The Partial On Mode Total Allowance is the maximum amount of power allowed in this mode for the model to be ENERGY STAR certified.

name: Partial On Mode Power Factor AC-Input
description: This indicates the Partial On Mode Power Factor for all AC-input models. If the model has a high resolution display with ABC enabled, this is the average Partial On Mode Power Factor for the high and low illuminance conditions.

name: Idle Mode Input Power (watts) AC- Input

name: Idle Mode Power Factor AC-Input
description: This indicates the Idle Mode Power Factor for all AC-input models. If the model has a high resolution display with ABC enabled, this is the average Idle Mode Power Factor for the high and low illuminance conditions.

name: Date Available On Market
description: The date that the model is available for purchase.

name: Date Certified
description: The date on which the product was confirmed to meet the ENERGY STAR specification.

name: Markets
description: Includes products sold in the U.S. and/or Canada and other ENERGY STAR partner countries.

name: CB Model Identifier
description: A unique string of characters assigned by certification bodies (CBs) to identify a model or set of models with the same performance characteristics. This identifier should remain the same for a model even if it is recertified to a new version of an ENERGY STAR specification. This string of characters is determined by CBs and is not the ENERGY STAR Unique ID assigned by EPA.
